name: Ghodo Ki Race Mein Ab Gadhe Bhi Daudenge
visual_description: Anil Kapoor as Majnu Bhai from the movie Welcome wearing sunglasses with his sidekicks, looking condescendingly.
usage_context: Used mockingly when an unqualified or unworthy person enters a competitive field or tries to compete with experts.

example.top_text: When backbenchers start applying for the same high-paying job as toppers

text_areas.description: Context or situation describing someone unqualified competing in a tough field
